planted_contradictions.detail: The driver says his light was green; the signal log shows Harbour Road turned red at 18:42:11, 20 s before the impact at 18:42:31.

The driver says about 30 mph (48 km/h) and that he braked; telematics show 46 to 51 km/h rising until impact, and the scene report records no braking marks from vehicle 1. The speed is consistent, the braking claim is not.
Both witnesses say about twenty to seven (18:40); telematics, the dashcam and the ambulance call all place it at 18:42:31.
